$comment: Which render each good uses. A pick is either "shipped" (keep the icon the game shipped with, and draw the card at that icon; a good with no shipped icon keeps its glyph) or { "card": "NN", "small": "NN" }, the variant numbers from a render batch's manifest.json: `card` is baked to card_<id>.webp (hand, trade lanes, pickers), `small` to icon_<id>.webp (costs, bank, log, tooltips, map builder). Bake with: node scripts/resource-art.mjs --src <render dir>.
